title: Fast flag on a tapestry
slide_intent: Pair a stable mark with a variable surface so recognition and visual variety can coexist.
strategic_value: The white fast flag over a green-blue texture can let Wise vary imagery without changing its identifier.
demonstration: A white fast flag sits centrally on a layered green, turquoise and blue textured portrait field.
practical_value: Evaluate contrast when placing a simple identifier on a detailed abstract background.

content_islands.name: Texture field
content_islands.spec: Fill the frame with the layered tapestry.

content_islands.name: Identifier
content_islands.spec: Center the white fast flag and preserve a clear silhouette against the detail.

reference_purposes.Expression: A white fast flag sits centrally on a layered green, turquoise and blue textured portrait field.
reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying Tapestries section identifies these textures as flexible recognizable assets inspired by the world’s money.

ingredient.name: Tapestry behind the fast flag
ingredient.role: Add varied visual texture around a stable identifier.
ingredient.application: Use a clear contrasting mark against the detailed field, as shown by the white flag here.
ingredient.scope: Observed case-study example; no mandatory contrast ratio or palette proportions are supplied.
